title: Update, rollback, recovery, and release qualification
objective: Deliver the update and recovery model and release path in docs/canonical/P12_INSTALLER_LIFECYCLE_DESIGN.md sections 7 and 8: explicit offline update from a verified release directory with downgrade refusal, configuration-schema compatibility, verified stop and restart, atomic activation, post-activation self-verification by the new version's own CLI with automatic restoration of the previous version on failure, explicit rollback to the retained previous version, interrupted- and failed-update reporting, a lifecycle transcript, a tag-triggered draft release workflow, and a CI job that packages a real release and qualifies the full lifecycle from that artifact.

include: cotra update --source <dir> with --check, --allow-downgrade, and --reinstall: candidate verified exactly as an install; downgrade refused unless explicitly allowed; configuration-schema range compatibility required before any change; running instance stopped with verified termination and restarted after success

state\update.json marker recording pending updates and failed updates with the reason; `cotra start` refuses to start while an update is pending, so no runtime can launch a version before its own self-check; doctor reports an interrupted (pending) update as a failure and a failed, restored update as a warning

post-activation verification by running the new version's own `cotra self-check`; on failure the previous pointer, CLI copy, and install record are restored and verified, the failed version directory is removed, an instance that was running before the update is restarted on the restored version, and the outcome is reported honestly

cotra rollback to the retained previous version after verifying its payload against its own manifest and its configuration-schema compatibility, swapping the active and previous versions in the pointer and install record
pruning to the active and previous versions after a successful update, including staging and invalid leftovers
logs\lifecycle.log transcript of install, update, rollback, and uninstall outcomes, redacted and bounded

.github/workflows/release.yml on v* tags: tag and workspace version must match, build, package, qualify the packaged release, archive, SHA256SUMS, and a draft GitHub Release; no publication without a maintainer

a release-qualification CI job on windows-latest that builds, packages with scripts/package-release.mjs, installs the packaged artifact, drives MCP initialize, tools/list (exact canonical tool set), and tools/call system_status through the installed real cotra-mcp app to cotrad, runs doctor, updates while running, refuses a downgrade, rolls back, recovers automatically from a release whose CLI cannot verify itself, stops with verification, and uninstalls with retention and purge
the tunnel fixture speaks MCP JSON-RPC for that qualification and still stands in only for the OpenAI client
exclude: automatic or network update checks, downloads, or background updates
SBOM, provenance attestation, reproducibility claims, and code signing, which are COTRA-P13 work
any MCP tool, agent capability, approval change, service, scheduled task, or elevation

authority_delta.filesystem: The human-invoked CLI replaces version payloads, the pointer, the CLI copy, the install record, and the update marker only beneath %LOCALAPPDATA%\Cotra. Configuration, secrets, and history are not modified by update or rollback.
authority_delta.process: The CLI runs the new version's `cotra self-check` and stops and restarts only its own supervisor. No agent process authority is added.
authority_delta.network: None. Updates are applied from a local release directory; the release workflow runs in GitHub Actions on tags.
authority_delta.secrets: None added. The CI qualification asserts the runtime key appears in no output or log.

invariants: the active version pointer always references a payload verified against its manifest, and no runtime starts while an update is pending, so a version activated by an update runs only after its own self-check
an update whose new version cannot verify itself leaves the previous version active and verified
downgrades require an explicit flag and incompatible configuration schemas change nothing
configuration, secrets, and history are untouched by update and rollback
no update activity happens without an explicit human command and a local release directory
the packaged release exposes exactly the canonical MCP tool set

acceptance.claim: Tests prove --check changes nothing, downgrades are refused without the flag, and incompatible configuration schemas are refused before any change.

Tests prove a failed self-check restores and verifies the previous version, records a failed marker, removes the failed version, and restarts an instance that was running, and that start is refused while an update is pending.
Tests prove rollback is refused without a retained previous version.

The release-qualification CI job proves, from a packaged release, install, MCP through the installed real app with the exact canonical tool set and a cotrad-backed tool call, a healthy doctor, update while running with restart, downgrade refusal, rollback with restart, automatic recovery from a broken release with doctor reporting it, verified stop, retaining uninstall, purge, and no runtime key in any output or log.
The release workflow parses, requires the tag to match the workspace version, qualifies the packaged release before archiving, and only creates a draft release.
All closed SG-000001 through SG-000043 regressions pass unchanged.

Exact-head Windows and Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, release qualification, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p12_exit: The P12 exit packet jointly proves clean install, start, status, doctor, tunnel path, bounded capability operation, stop, restart, upgrade, failed-update recovery, uninstall, and retained-data behavior from canonical evidence, and records owner-performed real ChatGPT connectivity as outside CI.
successor_requirements.p13: SBOM, provenance attestation, reproducibility testing, dependency and license review, and threat-model regression are COTRA-P13 work.

done_when: Explicit offline update with self-verification and automatic recovery, rollback, failure reporting, a draft-only release workflow, and CI qualification of the packaged release are specified with no agent-reachable authority.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: genuine TypeSafe Jev exact-diff review covered 34/34 hunks with zero findings and zero blocking findings, pin 31f89602797fb7bea007f8a480bf368bf564954e
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Alibaba Open Code Review v1.12.9 exact-range delegation over 17 changed files, 16 reviewable with delegated rules applied and 1 excluded (package-lock.json) manually reviewed
canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head: explicit offline update only, with no network update activity; candidates verified exactly as installs; downgrades require --allow-downgrade; incompatible configuration schemas change nothing; a per-install named-mutex lifecycle lock serializes install, uninstall, update, rollback, start, stop, and configuration commands; start refuses while an update is pending; every activated version is manifest-verified and self-checked by its own CLI before any runtime starts; failed self-checks, post-stop failures, and failed rollbacks restore and restart honestly; interrupted updates are recovered through the validated pending marker even when the pointer and install record disagree; rollback and recovery refuse links and reparse points in the install tree before reading retained versions; the lifecycle transcript never writes through links; npm dependencies are pinned by package-lock.json and packaging copies only the locked production closure; the release workflow only creates or refreshes a draft and never replaces a published release's assets; the release-qualification CI job qualifies the packaged artifact on a fresh windows-latest runner. 23 bot review threads were resolved with fixes; the SG-000013 PowerShell timing flake was repaired separately in PR #125.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Explicit offline update, rollback, interrupted- and failed-update recovery, a lifecycle lock, a draft-only release workflow, and release-artifact qualification are closed. No network update activity, silent migration, MCP tool, agent capability, approval change, service, or elevation is added.
